QuestInfo.name: Grandfather's Vitamin Gummy
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p111# in #m10000000# is willing to grant his grandson's request.
QuestInfo.1: I obtained the final ingredient for the #o17# phobia cure, the #t4031113#, from #p111# in #m10000000#. Now, all I need to do is bring this to #b#p404##k in #b#m10003000##k. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered all the ingredients for the #o17# phobia cure to #p404# in #m10003000#. Now, I can only hope that he crafts the cure properly.

0.0: You've gone through a lot because of my grandson. You see, I can't live even a single day without these #t4031113#s. But since it's a request from my dear grandson, I suppose I have no choice. Here, take this #b#t4031113##k.

yes.0: And tell that boy to come visit me more often!

1.0: You're back. What? Grandfather told me to visit more often? Yeah, yeah, I got it... But for now, let's focus on making the #o17# phobia cure.

npc.0: My precious #t4031113#... Take it to my grandson in #m10003000#. Ah, what a waste...

item.0: You're back. What a relief that Grandfather handed over the #t4031113# without a fuss. But wait... where is that #t4031113#?

lost.0: You lost my precious #t4031113#? How careless... I'll give it to you again, so make sure not to lose it this time.
